facebook.caption:
This place fixes burnout.

Mộc Cuisine Phú Quốc on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is the kind of bistro that slows you down. No rush. No tourist noise. Just good food, calm energy, and a bill that won't hurt ($15-30/person).

4.7 stars across 246 reviews. That's consistency, not luck.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
